lines.en: I need a good worker, you are strong, come on!
We don't go with that man.
I've seen several men go with that man, and none come back.
We don't know what he does with them.
I don't want to talk about it anymore.
I pick up day laborers and tell them that they'll get paid at 6pm.
At 5:45, a certain INS agent by the name of Mose Schrute throws them in the back of a van,
drops them off in the middle of Harrisburg, and tells them it's Canada.
Yes, I'm a very good worker.
And El Accento, uh, donde are you from?
Yes, I'm really good at English.
Okay, good. Me too. Get in the car.
Who is this guy by our cars?
That is my new maintenance worker, Nate.
And you'll be happy to know that he's taking care of that hornet's nest that you've been griping about.
Yeah, I got stung up my dress.
I've left him all the tools he needs.
If he chooses correctly, he'll conquer the hornets.
When did the phrase "do or die" become so corrupted?
